bio.text: Hal Rogers has represented Kentucky's 5th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives since 1981 and, since March 2022, has been Dean of the House as its longest-serving member.
He was born in rural Kentucky and chaired the House Appropriations Committee from 2011 through 2016.
In 2003 he was tapped to lead the first House Subcommittee on Homeland Security.
